name: Ramchandran
title: Master Stylist & Founder
description: With over 27 years of experience transforming looks and building confidence, Ramchandran has established Poongothai Family Salon as the premier destination for luxury hair and beauty services. To ensure the utmost comfort and privacy, all female styling and haircuts are hosted in a completely separate, dedicated salon space. These exclusive services are personally provided by Mrs. Ramachandran, ensuring a premium, tailored experience for our female clientele.
